title: Repository-host discovery pin race canary
mission: Exercise the canonical repository proposal-claim path with two or more competing create-if-absent attempts for one controlled fingerprint, prove exactly one durable winner, preserve winner bytes and collision evidence, and leave all results as candidate verification evidence only.

regression_prevention.reason: The current discovery contract depends on host-level exclusive create semantics; the implementation return explicitly marks repository-host race behavior as unverified.

unblock_value.reason: A host canary closes the remaining boundary before relying on proposal pins for drained-queue discovery under a large identical-worker wave.
